full_page.content:
1934, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 254 Cont.
Oct. Mary Krisak - 21 - threatened T. B. Mrs. Peters' Mother ... worse again Catherine Ames - 44 - again dizzy
28 Agnes Tarver - 45 - operated for goiter - 2 hrs & 25 min. under anesthetic - hope to avoid further Oper'n & mental.
Florence Wojkowski - 18 - paralysis, , has enrolled & .... wonders.
Mrs. Ring "Scientist" - 65 (about) hemoraging from cancer of breast. Doctors refused to operate. Comes to monastery and enrol- les then insists on operation - astonishingly improving. Deo Gr. Howard John Macey. .. 10 - Eye trouble - was blind last year ... James & E'd Coyle - 3 & 1 whooping-cough.
Page 255 Page 256
Blank Page
Oct. Mrs. Marfret Fox - 38 - blind since an accident 8 yrs. ago. Hus- band had never been baptized, had been given much to drinking .... Now he has become a practical Cath.
Frances Curran - 43 - applegate - poisoned system has 6 children ... Marg. Elliott ... middle aged .. . unjustly sued ....
Oct. 30 Edward Woods - 32 - neck trouble has wife and four small children to provide for. Hurt his neck in football while in high-school; has doctor'd much & in many places without results. Enrolled To- day (506)
Agusta Sagaert - 40 - cancer of breast. Dr. insisted at first on operation three weeks ago. Enrolled in Ser. Mass A. and promises 40 enrollments to poor SS. Reports To-day ..... "only 2 size now" Nov. 15 lump, as above Oct. 30 now only 1/3 as large and no pain ...... Jan. 13 growing again - another $5 Today for Poor Souls. March 26 '35 breast amputated.
Page 257 Blank Page
